author: vladthegreat100
body:
Hey Guys!
As you guys probably know that yesterday on the forums was chaos over the poor actions and false rumours that some of the staff and non-staff have done.
So I was thinking yesterday: "Why do our Admins leave so often and so quickly?"
I was thinking through and I realised that it was through all the stress that was put upon them in tough times in the server, they were just not mentally prepared to take on the job, and why is that? Lack of training when they were given the job.
Same for the Sr Staff where I'm sure most of us feel like there are the most problems with the Sr Staff, that reason is due to their actions they take (Name changes, how they write on threads, e.t.c.). It seems as they lack of in depth training, which I'm assuming they are only given the basics and to learn from their mistakes from the actions they have been making recently.

Thinking through that I also though, who were the most respected and successful Admins on the server throughout the Avicus history, and I figured it was Gill and Jozz. Exactly once I thought of their names and contacted them asking the following question:
"If you were able to help coach/give advice to sr's + to be mentally prepared for their job in game, on the forums, on teamspeak and plug.dj would you take the job?"
And happily the two said yes.

So my suggestion is, to allow Jozz & Gill to assist in Coaching the new Admins and all the Sr Staff to get them mentally prepared for whatever will happen in game, on the forums, on teamspeak and on plug.dj, and to show them how to act on any Avicus platform. Having new Admins in short periods of times is a bad thing for the community, we get used to one Admin's ways and then he resigns due to his reasons and we get another one where we aren't always open to the new ideas as we are used to the other Admin's ways.
This is a method of prevention to keep the server happy, and in the end we keep all of our Admins for a longer period of time and the decision making of Sr Staff and Admins will rise a lot.
 
This is how it would work [Will change as we go along]:
Admins: Gill and Jozz (or one of them alone) would go on a two on one, one on one or two on two (if the other admin who is older wants to watch) and they would give them tips/coach them to become more mentally and to know how to act on the Avicus platforms... Not immature. And of course to probably re-make the ban guide. Right now the ban guide is too generalised, it is not good as it can confuse the community by "I got this but he got that" and "You are so biased! We did the same thing and he got lower than me and it's the same offence!" Best to get a ban guide that gives you for this offence you ban for this amount of time, nothing more nothing less. That takes away all the confusion of the infractions given. And of course there will probably be more than just one session, as you do not learn these things in one sitting!
Sr Staff: Gill and Jozz will probably split up and start giving tips & training the Sr Staff [Jozz had a training plan for Sr Staff before retiring but never got in use] on how to act on the Avicus platforms, on how to be mentally prepared for the job as well as know how to train the moderators or get a bunch of tips on how to make the training for moderators. Same thing, more than one session. You never rush these things.
Moderators: Gill and Jozz will not be working with the moderators unless they really want to, I'm hoping to leave it to the Sr Staff who would have just gotten prepared to make a plan or who have just made a plan to train the moderators on how to act on all platforms, to be mentally prepared for the job and to know how to give the correct punishment on any platform, not just in game or on teamspeak!
Jr Moderators: Have the moderators train the Jr Moderators a bit on the new commands, the new features on the website, and what punishment to give. 
 
I do hope you guys accept this suggestion as it will help not only the community to settle down on what they are worried about but also improve the staff team drastically. Also remember Jozz and Gill were one of the most respected and successful Admins of their times being from being able to control and bring the community to not only the Avicore update but through the Omega update as well!
And for you staff members thinking that you are too good to get training... well look at the community and the things that have happened yesterday.
Let's try to find a solution to fix the Staff from their errors before thinking about demoting Staff Members.
Reassessments will only get rid of the problem, but when new batches come in those problems will be back. 
Fixing the Problem > Getting rid of the problem and attempting to replace it
Demoting should be a last resort option!

If any Sr Staff or admin want a bit more detail on it or clarification contact me on skype at vladthegreat100

Sincerely
~ vladthegreat100
